name: gdpr
description: GDPR Key Articles for Privacy Harm Detection

rules.title: Principles - Lawfulness, Fairness, Transparency
rules.condition: unlawful_processing OR unfair OR deceptive OR hidden_collection
rules.question_form: Is data processing lawful, fair, and transparent?
rules.description: Personal data shall be processed lawfully, fairly and transparently

rules.title: Principles - Purpose Limitation
rules.question_form: Is data only used for specified, explicit, and legitimate purposes?
rules.description: Data collected for specified, explicit and legitimate purposes

rules.title: Principles - Data Minimization
rules.question_form: Is data collection limited to what is necessary?
rules.description: Data shall be adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary

rules.title: Principles - Accuracy
rules.question_form: Is personal data accurate and kept up to date?
rules.description: Personal data shall be accurate and, where necessary, kept up to date

rules.title: Principles - Storage Limitation
rules.question_form: Is data retained only as long as necessary?
rules.description: Data kept in identifiable form no longer than necessary

rules.title: Principles - Integrity and Confidentiality
rules.condition: breach OR unauthorized_access OR leak OR insecurity
rules.question_form: Is data protected against unauthorized access and accidental loss?
rules.description: Appropriate security including protection against unauthorized processing

rules.title: Lawful Basis - Consent
rules.condition: no_consent OR invalid_consent OR bundled_consent OR pre_ticked
rules.question_form: Is there valid consent or other lawful basis for processing?
rules.description: Processing only lawful if based on consent or other legal grounds

rules.title: Conditions for Consent
rules.question_form: Is consent freely given, specific, informed, and unambiguous?
rules.description: Controller must demonstrate consent; data subject can withdraw

rules.title: Special Categories - Sensitive Data
rules.condition: health_data OR biometric OR genetic OR racial OR political OR religious OR sexual
rules.question_form: Is sensitive/special category data processed without explicit consent?
rules.description: Processing of special categories prohibited without explicit consent

rules.title: Transparent Information
rules.question_form: Is information about data processing provided in a clear manner?
rules.description: Information provided in concise, transparent, intelligible form

rules.title: Data Subject Rights
rules.condition: denied_access OR no_portability OR no_erasure OR ignored_request
rules.question_form: Are data subject rights (access, erasure, portability) respected?
rules.description: Rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection

rules.title: Data Protection by Design and Default
rules.question_form: Is privacy built into systems by design and default?
rules.description: Appropriate technical and organizational measures by design and default

rules.title: Processor Obligations
rules.question_form: Are processor relationships properly governed by contracts?
rules.description: Processing by a processor governed by a contract

rules.title: Security of Processing
rules.question_form: Is there appropriate security for the processing?
rules.description: Appropriate technical and organizational security measures

rules.title: Breach Notification
rules.question_form: Are data breaches notified within 72 hours?
rules.description: Notification of breach to supervisory authority within 72 hours

rules.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment
rules.condition: high_risk_processing OR profiling OR large_scale AND no_dpia
rules.question_form: Has a DPIA been conducted for high-risk processing?
rules.description: Impact assessment required for high-risk processing

rules.title: Administrative Fines - Higher Tier
rules.question_form: Is this a serious violation warranting higher-tier fines?
rules.description: Up to €20M or 4% of global annual turnover

rules.title: Administrative Fines - Lower Tier
rules.question_form: Is this a technical or organizational violation?
rules.description: Up to €10M or 2% of global annual turnover
